title: karatas humilis
intro: Karatas humilis, commonly known as "Cordia" or "Wild Plum," is a plant species that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Karatas humilis include its use as a cardiac stimulant, diuretic, and expectorant, making it a potential remedy for various respiratory and cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of Karatas humilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health issues.
